sources: Jiangsu Changjiang Electronics Technology (JSCJ) 2SC1815 TO-92 transistor (NPN), revision A (November 2012), LCSC's copy for C23895 https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/d08962a70643408a86b9913fad8cc4c1.pdf?productCode=C23895, read 2026-10-31. The type is Toshiba's; Toshiba's own data sheet was not reachable – its product page (toshiba.semicon-storage.com …/detail.2SC1815.html) loads its documents by script, and /info/docget.jsp and /info/lookup.jsp answer 404 for 2SC1815 –, so JSCJ's 2SC1815 of the GR rank stands in
pins 1 emitter, 2 collector, 3 base: p. 1 TO-92 (1.EMITTER 2.COLLECTOR 3.BASE) – as the KiCad symbol Transistor_BJT:2SC1815 of the designs (1 E, 2 C, 3 B)
vce_max_v 50, veb_max_v 5, ic_max_a 0.15, p_max_w 0.4, rth_ja_k_per_w 312, tj_max_c 150, t_min_c −55: p. 1 maximum ratings (VCBO 60 V has no field)

hfe_min 200, hfe_max 400: p. 1 hFE classification, rank GR 200–400 – C23895 is sold as 'RANGE:200-400'; the type's whole range is 70–700 at VCE 6 V, IC 2 mA (ranks O 70–140, Y 120–240, GR 200–400, BL 350–700), the schematic names no rank
vce_sat_v 0.25: p. 1 VCE(sat) maximum at IC = 100 mA, IB = 10 mA
icbo_a 100 nA at 25 °C: p. 1 ICBO maximum at VCB = 60 V – no temperature curve, the one value as it is

spice: assumption – Gummel-Poon fitted by Claude: BF 283, the geometric mean of the GR rank (the typical hFE graph of p. 2 shows about 170 at 25 °C, a part of no stated rank); IS 26 fA from the IC–VBE curve of p. 2 at 25 °C (about 0.63 V at 1 mA, read from the graph); IKF 0.2 A so that the gain falls towards the hFE graph's 100 at 150 mA
notes: General-purpose NPN in TO-92 (Toshiba's type, here JSCJ's GR rank): the input and output emitter followers of the Tubescreamer. Its hFE spread is a corner of the simulation (sim.json spread, maker-coverage FT-17). Library draft.

checked: p. 1: VCBO 60 V, VCEO 50 V, VEBO 5 V, IC 150 mA, PC 400 mW, RθJA 312 °C/W, TJ 150 °C
p. 1: hFE 70–700, ranks O/Y/GR/BL; ICBO ≤ 0.1 µA (60 V); VCE(sat) ≤ 0.25 V
p. 2: typical hFE and IC–VBE curves
open: a second source: Toshiba's own 2SC1815 data sheet not reachable
the rank (GR) is the stand-in's; the designs name none – a part of rank O or Y biases the followers lower
SPICE model fitted by Claude, not a manufacturer model
